messages:
statusbot: Incident broadcast: elevated 503 errors observed across multi-region ingress (eu-west + us-west). Start: ~10:12 UTC. ~7% of generation requests returning 503. Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2048201234. Please post triage to #incidents and mitigation chatter to #eng-runtime.

anya (sre): Investigating. Initial signal: LB retry loops and backend connection exhaustion. Correlates with a kernel-tuning hotpatch deployed at 09:58 that modified keepalive/timeouts.

mike (support): Seeing ~12 customer tickets in the last 15m, a few enterprise escalations. Drafting proactive note.

jen (eng-runtime): Confirmed hotpatch touched TCP keepalive path. Rolling back the hotpatch in eu-west now; will validate then roll back us-west.

ops-bot: Autoscale: +6 serving nodes added across eu-west/us-west (actions: act-9751, act-9752).

sara (sre): Applied temporary per-route rate limiter for noisy clients (rl-temporary-2048) to reduce retry amplification while rollback proceeds.

support_oncall: Proactive customer message ready: "We9re aware of elevated 503s on generation endpoints, engineers are mitigating. ETA update in 15m. See https://status.redwood.example/incident/2048201234." Waiting SRE ack to send.

miguel (platform): Noted KV-cache eviction spike concurrent with failures; eviction +12% in eu-west pools 10m window. Gathering traces.

anya (sre): eu-west rollback in progress; error rate dropping from ~8% to ~1.5% over 6 minutes. us-west still ~2%, rollback queued.

jen (eng-runtime): eu-west rollback finished, health checks green. Starting us-west rollback and rolling ingress proxies to clear stuck connections.

mike (support): Sending proactive CS note now with status page link.

ops-bot: Rollback confirmed for eu-west. us-west rollback 45% complete. Autoscale stable.

anya (sre): Current metrics: eu-west 503 ~1.2%, us-west ~0.9%. Monitoring for regressions. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/ingress-503-response.

jen (eng-runtime): Trace snippet that diagnosed the issue: "TCP retransmit timeout xN; keepalive unexpected close; LB retry loop -> backend conn saturate". Root cause follow-up planned.

support_oncall: CS update sent at 10:37 UTC.

miguel (platform): Eviction metrics stabilizing toward baseline. Capturing histograms for postmortem.

anya (sre): 30m update: incident mitigated, 503s returned to baseline across regions. Root cause: side-effect from kernel tuning hotpatch altering keepalive semantics under retry storms; amplified by bursty clients. Postmortem owner: jen (eng-runtime). Postmortem ETA: 48h. Closing broadcast. :white_check_mark:
